title: CatalogFix AI input
description: Text-only automatic supplier processing: machine-readable PDF, CSV and XLSX. Scanned/image-only or ambiguous PDFs require manual review before gateway acceptance. No automatic OCR. Rows are classified Ready / Needs Review; missing facts are not invented.

catalogFile.title: Supplier catalog
catalogFile.description: One machine-readable PDF, CSV or XLSX. Legacy XLS unsupported by gateway. Use an approved direct HTTPS source.

filenameOverride.title: Filename override (optional)
filenameOverride.description: Use only when the uploaded URL does not preserve a file extension. Example: supplier_catalog.pdf

automaticTextOnly.title: Automatic text-only mode
automaticTextOnly.description: Fixed to true. This dedicated build cannot enable visual OCR.
